description: KPI Plume shows your key figures as cards: one card per measure, or one per region, product or team with a Total card. Each card brings the value (exact over the period, even for a rate), the change versus last period or last year, progress toward the target, a trend line and an icon. On hover or click the card flips to explain the number. Free features, no watermark Cards that always fit: automatic grid, row or column, no scroll bar; blank KPIs can be hidden. Comparison with a field, the previous or the first period: %, value, arrows, neutral zone. Target per card: a field or a value typed for the card; progress bar; green, amber or red from thresholds. Trend as a line or an area, at the bottom, in the background or on the right, with min/max markers. 134 built-in icons by theme, picked per KPI or given by a measure; a link button per card. Back of the card: a definition or a text with placeholders, and the key figures you choose KPI by KPI, including measures shown only on the back. Cross-filtering from per-category cards, tooltips, keyboard, screen readers, right-click menu. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. Your colors: follows the report theme; custom colors; Minimal and Black & White styles; high contrast, English and French. Premium features ★ Second comparison: budget and last year on the same card.
